darius (AE): Putting together the Convex POC schedule. They need documented latency/throughput results before procurement. Requirements: sustain 300 qps for 30m with p99 < 150ms, verify cold-start < 800ms, and validate 10m bursts to 1k qps. Also they sent a short security checklist. Can we run Wed smoke + Thu stress?
elaine (SE): Yep. Proposed test matrix:
- Wed: smoke (10m) to validate env + KV warmup
- Thu AM: sustained run (30m at 300 qps)
- Thu PM: stress with 3x bursts to 1k qps for 10m windows
We suggest model: rwin-13b-quant (cost-friendly) with fallback rwin-6b. Will include 2% embedding calls.
chris (SRE): Need exact payload distribution. Ask Convex for: avg input tokens, expected output tokens, and rate of embeddings (you said 2%). I'll schedule Dedicated pool for Thu to avoid noisy neighbors. Also we should do a 10m warm phase to prefill KV cache.
darius (AE): Convex says avg input ~45 tokens, output ~55 tokens. Embeddings occur ~1/50 calls, call size small. They want cost comparison hosted vs dedicated for the sustained hour and for the burst minutes.
elaine (SE): Quick hosted cost back-of-envelope: assume 100 tokens per call (45+55), cost per token ~ $0.00075 -> $0.075 per call. At 300 qps for 1h (~1.08M calls) that's ~ $81k. Burst 1k qps for 10m (~600k calls) ~ $45k. These are rough; dedicated will be much lower per-token. I'll send a spreadsheet with detailed calc.
darius (AE): Share the spreadsheet asap; they'll negotiate.
olivia (Security): On security checklist: they asked about KMS, network isolation, audit log retention, and SOC2 evidence. We offer VPC Private, customer KMS/HSM for Private deployments, and 90-day audit logs by default. They specifically asked if we can do 12mo log retention and HSM-managed keys.
chris (SRE): 12mo logs are available as an add-on; we'll need billing sign-off. For the run, pass logs to the S3 bucket we control and set retention per their request.
olivia (Security): Confirming: Hosted -> we can use cloud KMS (not customer HSM). Private -> supports customer HSM. I'll attach SOC2 link and a templated answer.
elaine (SE): Load runner details: we'll provide a service account with API key and a sample locust script. Example request for both chat + embedding:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rwin-13b-quant",
  "input": "<sample prompt>",
  "max_tokens": 64
}
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "embed-lite", "input": "<small>" }
```
We'll export histograms for p50/p95/p99 and per-worker GPU util.
darius (AE): Can we have an automatic canary route to 6b if p99 > 500ms for 2+ minutes? Convex wants graceful degradation.
elaine (SE): Yes, we can configure a threshold fallback policy. We'll validate during stress run.
chris (SRE): I'll provision 3 x A100-equivalent nodes in Dedicated pool for the sustained run (should handle 300 qps for 13b-quant with slack). Will capture cold-start by cycling the worker once before the warm phase and noting first-request latencies.
darius (AE): Schedule locked for Wed/Thu PST. I'll send Convex the AUP and service account creds. Also confirm they can run load from our test runner or they want to run from their infra.
olivia (Security): One potential deal blocker: Convex requires HSM for keys in production. We can do that on Private, but Hosted won't meet that requirement without special arrangement. Flagging for AE.
darius (AE): Got it. I'll surface that in the call. Any final run blockers?
elaine (SE): Need Convex contact + IPs for allowlist, plus a signed AUP. After tests we'll produce a one-page report: throughput timeline, tail-latency heatmap, token burn & cost projection, recommended model/quant + cache settings. Draft within 24h of test completion.
eval-bot: [run queued] scenario: convex-poc-2026-03 id: ep-774.
darius (AE): Thanks team. Please paste final locust script, exact dedicated sizing, and security answers by EOD Monday so I can prep the deck. :thumbsup:
